items.title: Sony Vizha to launch on October 19 with Tamil Idol, Celebrity MasterChef
items.sum: Sony Pictures Networks India is launching a new Tamil general entertainment channel named Sony Vizha on October 19 at 8 p.m. The channel will feature Tamil culture-focused content including series, films, live cricket, and reality programming. Notable highlights on the network include Tamil Idol and Celebrity MasterChef Tamil. A. R. Rahman and Samantha Ruth Prabhu will serve as judges on the new shows. Additional programming will feature real-life crime cases and friendship-themed series set in Tamil Nadu.
